meta.source: Nonfiction Hotlist brand guide (two-page PNG export), revised first pass November 2026

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Palette. Logo and type on green and dark grounds; light page ground.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Palette. Soft light ground for the black logo and long reading.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Palette. Signature green, the flat stand-in for the green gradient. White text on it only at 18px bold or 24px+ (4.4:1).

tokens.name: green-glow
tokens.usage: Palette. Light stop of the green gradient (top-left).

tokens.name: green-shade
tokens.usage: Palette. Dark stop of the green gradient (bottom-right).

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Palette. Deep green for buttons, headings on light grounds, links. White on it is 7.7:1.

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: Palette. Light stop of the forest gradient (bottom-right).

tokens.name: pine-deep
tokens.usage: Palette. Dark stop of the forest gradient (top-left); flat dark panels.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Palette. Logo on light grounds, QR panels.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: Palette. The one warm accent: year tags, a headline's closing period, a single sparkle, focus rings. Never text on white (1.9:1); black on spark is 11:1.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Palette. Core of the warm glow behind hero wordmarks, always blurred into spark. Never a flat fill.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Cards and secondary panels on surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Flat brand fields where a gradient can't render (email, print spot color).

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Buttons and the dark brand panel.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and logo on brand, brand-deep and both gradients.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Alias of spark for components: tags and the closing period.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent tags.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and logo on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Section titles, captions and taglines on surface (6.9:1 on paper; 11:1 on pine-deep).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and the co-brand separator.

tokens.name: gradient-green
tokens.usage: The default brand ground: heroes, posters, logo panels, the green social cards. Light at top-left, darker at bottom-right.

tokens.name: gradient-forest
tokens.usage: The dark brand ground: personality and team cards, footers, dark logo panels.

tokens.name: gradient-glow
tokens.usage: Hero only: soft warm glow behind the wordmark, laid over gradient-green.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: League Spartan Bold. Always lowercase, tight tracking.

styles.name: logo
styles.usage: The wordmark. Use the logo files, not live type, wherever possible.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels and eyebrows, lowercase and tracked. Replaces the third face in the old guide.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Roboto Serif for subtitles and all reading text. Sentence case.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: The pulse of what's next in nonfiction

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Six films, two series and a podcast worth your time.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs and subheads in long copy.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Premiered at Tribeca and still looking for a distributor.
styles.usage: All body copy. Left aligned, never justified.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Film, series and podcast titles inside copy: italic, in their released case.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: scan to join our email list

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and callouts.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Padding inside buttons and QR cards.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gutters between blocks; inner margin of cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page margins; social card safe area at 1080px.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Color fields and panels. The brand's blocks are square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: QR cards, film cards, photo frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: URL chips, tags and portraits.
